facts.text: PALService is the PAL3 robot service: its constructor creates the DirectFactory driver, starts routing, resolves the configuration and direct services and calls start_remote_service
When no host is given, the constructor uses the PAL1 address 192.168.99.230
At import PAL3_driver imports clr and keyboard, adds a reference to System, calls os.getlogin(), appends a Windows Dropbox path to sys.path and imports CustomTracker and ContainerManager from it
The upstream MADSci node constructs PALService and calls std_start('test') at startup
std_start locks the left head, creates a new execution session, sends a status message and homes the arm

set_active_modules calls std_PAL1_start only when the host is the PAL1 address and std_nmr_start only when it is the NMR address; std_PAL1_start looks up the fast wash, wash, waste, centrifuge, vortex, dilutor, gripper, syringe and dilutor tool modules by name
get_current_pos calls GetArmPosition and get_xyz converts the returned EuclideanVector from metres to millimetres
move_absolute creates a MoveAbsolute activity, sets DestinationX, DestinationY and DestinationZ with units.GetMilliMeter, calls session.Execute and then get_current_pos

move_relative creates a MoveRelative activity, sets MovementX, MovementY and MovementZ with units.GetMilliMeter for the non-zero components only, sets ForceDirectMovement, calls session.Execute and then get_current_pos
safe_home is defined twice with the same body: safe_getout, which moves relative only when safe.inside is set, then MoveToHome, then safe.inside is cleared
set_vial resolves the address with set_pos/GetVial and allocates a vial from the current execution session

move_gripper checks the target and then the source with detect_object; when the target is free and the source is found it executes the grab activity, moves above the target with gripper2object, moves the adapter to gr.width, grips and returns 0, otherwise it calls LeaveObject and returns 1
gripper_distance reads GenericGripperGetAdapterDistance and converts the reported metres to millimetres
clean_wash rinses the source liner twice and the syringe at 50 percent for two cycles
stop_remote_service calls remote_service.Disconnect when IsConnected is true and does nothing else
start_remote_service resolves IRemoteService, calls Remote.Connect and then, in a finally block, direct_service.Reset, calling sys.exit(0) when Reset raises
do_lock tries the left-head lock five times, calls stop_remote_service and then start_remote_service after a lock exception, and calls sys.exit(0) when every attempt failed
tm_sequence checks self.pause or ctrl+q at the start of each iteration of its transfer-map loop and returns self.transfer when either is set
centrifuge_sequence checks self.pause or ctrl+q at the start of each iteration of its while loop and returns self.transfer when either is set
The constructor imports .NET System and Ctc.Palplus.Integration.Driver
add_assembly calls sys.exit(0) when the named DLL is not found under self.dir
The upstream README says the module is a work in progress and needs testing and validation on the real instrument

safe_state.description: No acknowledged stop: the e-stop calls stop_remote_service(), which only disconnects the PAL remote service, and then reports SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED with the latch held; the clone has no motion-stop, abort or halt command and does not show what a disconnect does to a running activity, so an arm already moving may keep moving
